OUR SERVICES

Complete Nail Care & Beauty
Services

From classic manicures to creative nail art — we offer a full range of services using premium products for lasting results.

01

Manicure

Indulge in tailored hand therapy featuring meticulous cuticle grooming, soothing hot lotion massage, warm paraffin wax infusion, and chip-resistant gel or classic polish.

From $45 – $70 BOOK SESSION
02

Pedicure Spa

Rejuvenate tired feet with therapeutic sea salt soaks, intensive callus smoothing, organic sugar scrub exfoliation, deep-hydrating paraffin wax, and calming hot stone massage.

From $50 – $80 BOOK SESSION
03

SNS Dipping Powder

An odorless, liquid-free dipping technique fortified with 5 essential vitamins and calcium. Lightweight, natural-feeling durability in radiant solid tones, French tips, or soft ombre.

From $75 – $90 BOOK SESSION
04

Nail Enhancement & Full Set

Full acrylic and gel extensions sculpted to your favorite silhouette — from classic white tips to pink & white and ombre powders, plus precise refills and bespoke hand-painted nail art.

From $65 & up BOOK SESSION
05

Waxing & Beauty Care

Complete head-to-toe beauty care: gentle facial & body waxing, lush Eyelash Extensions, deep-cleansing rejuvenating Facials, and semi-permanent Eyebrow Tattooing.

From $10 – $400 BOOK SESSION

Our Story

Warm & Personal Care
In the Heart of Sidney

At Sidney Nails, we believe self-care should feel unhurried, comfortable, and truly restorative. Located on North Central Avenue, our salon was created to bring high standards of cleanliness, skilled artistry, and genuine Montana warmth to every guest who walks through our doors.

Whether you are stopping by for regular nail upkeep or spending an afternoon relaxing with our signature spa pedicure, our team takes the time to listen, care, and deliver beautiful results tailored to you.
